dyadID.Description: ID number for each dyad. Same generation dyads are in range 1001-1030 and intergenerational dyads are in range 2001-2031.

pID1.Description: ID number of one participant per dyad (1 and 2 arbitrarily assigned). Younger adults were assigned IDs in ranges 101-146 or 201-245 and older adults were assigned IDs in range 301-331.

qual_pID1.Description: Subjective comments made by participant 1 of a given dyad at the end of the session.
qual_pID1.ItemENG: We would like to understand your experience better. Please describe how you perceived the art activities.
qual_pID1.ItemGER: Wir möchten Ihre Erfahrung heute besser verstehen. Können Sie kurz beschreiben, wie Sie die Kunstaktivitäten empfunden haben?

pID2.Description: ID number of second participant per dyad (1 and 2 arbitrarily assigned).Younger adults were assigned IDs in ranges 101-146 or 201-245 and older adults were assigned IDs in range 301-331.

qual_pID2.Description: Subjective comments made by participant 2 of a given dyad at the end of the session.
qual_pID2.ItemENG: We would like to understand your experience better. Please describe how you perceived the art activities.
qual_pID2.ItemGER: Wir möchten Ihre Erfahrung heute besser verstehen. Können Sie kurz beschreiben, wie Sie die Kunstaktivitäten empfunden haben?
